rows.current: text: 我经验这么丰富，当然知道要最快把他们哄得合我心意，就是先让他们觉得自己掌控了局面。哈！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: was to allow them to feel like they were in control at first. Hah!

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Unlike you generalized Cosmoagents, a Top Agent such as myself would never
rows.current: text: 跟你们普通宇宙特工不同，我这样的上位特工绝不会屈服于后穴那低贱的肉欲。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: give in to such lowly desires of the anal flesh.

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: But of course, once another group of kobolds merged with my original targets
rows.current: text: 不过嘛，又一群科博德跟我最初的目标会合后，为免他们闹起来，我只好装成被彻底征服的样子。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: I had to put up the charade of being subjugated in order to prevent a riot of sorts.

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Unrelatedly, did you hear that Kobold males have these stimulating nubs
rows.current: text: 说点题外话，你听说过雄性科博德龟头上下两侧那些刺激的小肉突吗？

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: along the top and bottom of their glans?

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: I performed my duty only perfunctorily, of course, so I didn't notice...
rows.current: text: 当然，我只是敷衍尽责，并没留意……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: But some claim that even males can achieve orgasm by riding the Kobold organ.
rows.current: text: 但据说就连雄性，骑上科博德的鸡巴也能达到高潮。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Ahem, anyways, by the time I had managed to placate the group of rowdy lizards
rows.current: text: 咳，总之，等我安抚好那群闹腾的蜥蜴，我已被强烈的倦意吞没。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: a great tiredness had taken over me.

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Waking up, I found myself shackled up on the wall like you discovered me.
rows.current: text: 醒来时，我就被铐在墙上，跟你发现我时一样。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: There's nothing much to report from my time relaxing against the wall.
rows.current: text: 靠在墙上休息那段时间，没什么好报告的。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: I bided my time as the Kobolds tired themselves out doing whatever it is they do
rows.current: text: 我静候时机，等科博德们忙活到筋疲力尽

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: But did you know some of the other male agents (not me, of course) claim to have
rows.current: text: 不过你知道吗，有些男特工（当然不是我）居然声称，自己光靠口交刺激就射了！荒唐！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: achieved ejaculation thanks to being orally stimulated, even! Preposterous!

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Anyways, most of this footage is inconsequential and not worth reviewing.
rows.current: text: 总之，这些录像大多无关紧要，不值得回看。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Best that you leave the data review process to the professionals.
rows.current: text: 数据审查这种事，你最好交给专业人士。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Now excuse me rookie, I have to gather up my equipment and file a report.
rows.current: text: 失陪了，菜鸟。我得收拾装备，再交份报告。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: I just hope I...
rows.current: text: 只希望我……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: ...d o n ' t...accidentally run into a group of male kobolds once more...
rows.current: text: ……千、万、别……再不小心撞上一群雄性科博德……

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: Oh brave hero, thank you for rescuing me and proving your courage.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 勇敢的英雄啊，感谢你救出我，证明了你的勇气。

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: Now, place your hands upon mine.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 现在，把你的双手放在我的手上。

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: Turn your mind inward and witness the events that have shaped these lands...
rows.current: lang(Fox): 将心神转向内在，见证塑造这片土地的往事……

rows.source: ...I can see...!
rows.current: text: ……我能看见了……！

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: We, the Fenfen, have lived for eons on this planet that you know as "Tutone".
rows.current: lang(Fox): 我们Fenfen，在你们称作“图托恩”的星球上已生活了无数岁月。

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: Having eschewed the sort of technological advances that your culture thrives on
rows.current: lang(Fox): 摒弃了你们的文化赖以繁荣的那类技术进步之后，

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: we have lived simple, satisfying lives in harmony with the planet itself.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 我们与星球本身和谐共处，过着简单而满足的生活。

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: Quiet and modest are the best ways to describe us Fenfen.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 安静谦逊，最适合形容我们Fenfen。

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: All major quarrels were sorted out by a council of the wisest ESPers we had.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 所有重大争端，都由我们最睿智的超能力者组成的议会裁决。

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: With our highly attuned senses and powers, we were able to find solutions that
rows.current: lang(Fox): 凭借敏锐的感官与力量，我们总能找到办法，

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: benefitted all of society at once.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 能让整个社会一同受益。

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: However, even with our attunement...
rows.current: lang(Fox): 然而，即便有着这份感应力……

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: ...we were not able to sense that amongst us ESPers lay one whose ambitions
rows.current: lang(Fox): ……我们竟未察觉，超能力者之中藏着一人，其野心

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: would throw the very planet itself into chaos...
rows.current: lang(Fox): 会令整颗星球陷入混乱……

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.current: lang(Fox): ……

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: ...her name was Traeh.
rows.current: lang(Fox): ……她的名字是Traeh。

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: Gifted beyond her years, with an uncanny ability to find solutions others missed
rows.current: lang(Fox): 天赋远超其年纪，又有着总能找到他人所遗漏之解法的非凡本事，

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: the ESPer Traeh seemed like a fine addition to the council.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 超能力者Traeh，看上去是议会的一位出色新成员。

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: She was readily granted access to the stores of power that we Fenfen kept.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 她很轻易便获准接触我们Fenfen所封存的力量贮藏。

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: Power... that she then proceeded to corrupt.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 力量……而她随即着手将其腐化。

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: Absorbing ancient caches of ESPer power that were left by previous generations
rows.current: lang(Fox): 吸收了前代遗留下来的古老超能力者力量贮藏之后，

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: Traeh was left deeply disfigured, down to her very core.
rows.current: lang(Fox): Traeh从外貌到内心，都已扭曲得面目全非。

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: Maybe if we, the remaining elder ESPers of the council, reacted faster
rows.current: lang(Fox): 也许我们议会中剩下的超能力者长老若能更快应对

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: then we could've prevented the calamity that was about to befall our people.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 或许就能阻止那场即将降临族人的浩劫。

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: Alas, we did not, and that will forever be our greatest failing...
rows.current: lang(Fox): 可惜我们没有，这永远是我们最大的过失……

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: Now go, destined hero.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 去吧，命定的英雄。

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: Free my brothers and sisters and restore peace to the land!
rows.current: lang(Fox): 解救我的兄弟姐妹，让这片土地重归安宁！

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: Oh brave hero, thank you for rescuing me and proving your courage.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 勇敢的英雄啊，感谢你救出我，证明了你的勇气。

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: Now, place your hands upon mine.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 现在，把你的双手放在我的手上。

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: Turn your mind inward and witness the events that have shaped these lands...
rows.current: lang(Fox): 将心神转向内在，见证塑造这片土地的往事……

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: Having touched the prison of Traeh, the interloper was no longer themself.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 触碰Traeh的牢笼后，闯入者便不再是原来的自己。

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: Enough dark psychic power had passed in that one moment of contact
rows.current: lang(Fox): 就在接触的那一刻，已有足够多的黑暗灵能传递了过去，

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: that Traeh had a willing minion to send out into the wild.
rows.current: lang(Fox): Traeh也就有了一个甘愿效命的爪牙，可被差往荒野。

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: One by one, this twisted agent rounded up the remaining council members
rows.current: lang(Fox): 这名扭曲的特工，把余下的议员逐一抓走，

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: ensuring that the powers that kept Traeh imprisoned weakened more each day.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 以此确保囚禁Traeh的力量一天天地衰弱下去。

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: Even if the wise council members were intent on psychically detaining Traeh
rows.current: lang(Fox): 即便睿智的议会成员决意以心灵之力拘禁Traeh，

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: after being subjugated to experiment after dark experiment...
rows.current: lang(Fox): 可在遭受一场又一场黑暗实验之后……

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: ...not even the wisest of Fenfen minds could wage battles on that many fronts.
rows.current: lang(Fox): ……即便是Fenfen中最智慧的头脑，也无法在如此众多的战线上同时作战。

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: Without the powers of the Fenfen council to hold Traeh prisoner
rows.current: lang(Fox): 没了Fenfen议会的力量囚禁Traeh

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: it's only a matter of time before she's able to break free and wage war once more.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 她挣脱束缚、再度掀起战争，只是时间问题。

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: And this time, there will be no resistance against her evil power.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 而这一次，再没人能抵挡她的邪恶力量。

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: The only thing that keeps this evil Queen from conquering all of Tutone
rows.current: lang(Fox): 唯一让这邪恶女王尚未征服整个图托恩的，

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: is her desire to gain enough strength to transfer into a new host body.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 只是她想先积攒足够的力量，转移到新的宿主身体里。

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: Perhaps, then, it is another twist of Fate that sent you to this planet
rows.current: lang(Fox): 那么，或许又是命运的转折，将你送来这颗星球，

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: and had you arrive so near to where all this calamitous action took place.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 并且让你来到距离这场灾难发生之地如此之近的地方。

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: Will you be an even more powerful host for Traeh, Queen of Darkness?
rows.current: lang(Fox): 你会成为黑暗女王Traeh更强大的宿主吗？

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: Or will you be the saviour of the Fenfen, a beacon of courage and hope...?
rows.current: lang(Fox): 还是说，你会成为Fenfen的救星，勇气与希望的明灯……？

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.current: lang(Fox): ……

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: ...Only you can decide, hero.
rows.current: lang(Fox): ……只有你能决定，英雄。

rows.source: Wow, I wasn't expecting a rowdy fella like you around here!
rows.current: text: 哇，没想到这里有你这么闹腾的家伙！

rows.source: Didn't mean to be so rough with you, but you know how it is!
rows.current: text: 不是故意下手这么重的，可你也懂嘛！

rows.source: Maybe next time we can just talk it out instead of fighting, huh?
rows.current: text: 下次咱们也许可以好好谈谈，而不是动手，对吧？

rows.source: On the bright side, looks like some of my gear ended up in here.
rows.current: text: 往好处想，看来有些我的装备也掉进这里了。

rows.source: And here it is, my trusty sideblade.
rows.current: text: 找到了，我那可靠的佩刃。

rows.source: Not a particularly strong Lighttazer, but...
rows.current: text: 这把光电击枪威力不算大，不过……

rows.source: ...it's definitely a privilege to carry such an elegant weapon as this.
rows.current: text: ……能带着这么精致的武器，真是荣幸。

rows.source: It's my duty as a Cosmobreeder to take care of it!
rows.current: text: 身为宇宙育种者，保养它是我的职责！

rows.source: Ever since I was a pup, I had always wanted to be a Cosmobreeder.
rows.current: text: 从小狗崽时起，我就一直想当宇宙育种者。

rows.source: Traveling through the stars... Documenting new types of fauna...
rows.current: text: 穿梭星海……记录新发现的动物种类……

rows.source: ...I knew that was a dangerous job filled with excitement and adventure
rows.current: text: ……我早知道这是一份危险、又充满刺激与冒险的工作，

rows.source: and that's what I was born to do!
rows.current: text: 而我生来就是干这个的！

rows.source: After working my tail off for all those years, here I am now.
rows.current: text: 拼死拼活努力了那么多年，如今我总算站到了这里。

rows.source: On my very first mission to help solve a planet's eco-crisis!
rows.current: text: 第一次出任务，就要帮助解决一颗星球的生态危机！

rows.source: It's a huge responsibility, but this is what my training was all for.
rows.current: text: 责任重大，但我接受训练，正是为了这一刻。

rows.source: First step of the mission is to establish contact with the local fauna!
rows.current: text: 任务第一步，就是与当地动物建立联系！

rows.source: ...and they didn't mean with my fists!
rows.current: text: ……可不是说用拳头联系！

rows.source: So now that I have you here, maybe you can help me out, whattayasay?
rows.current: text: 既然你就在这儿，也许能帮我点忙，你说呢？

rows.source: If you know of any other strange agent-types that are down here could yo-
rows.current: text: 要是你知道这下面还有其他奇怪的特工模样的人，能不能——

rows.source: What the heck!!
rows.current: text: 什么鬼！！

rows.source: Where are you going???
rows.current: text: 你上哪儿去？？？

rows.source: I'm not gonna fight anymore! Come back here!!
rows.current: text: 我不会再动手了！回来啊！！

rows.source: You're the only lead I have and... oh darn it!
rows.current: text: 你可是我唯一的线索，而且……哦，真可恶！

rows.source: Wah! There we go!
rows.current: text: 哈！搞定啦！

rows.source: Could probably have taken you out in one smack if they gave me a better tazer
rows.current: text: 要是给我把好点的电击器，而不是这套弱得可怜的见习装备，我大概一击就能放倒你。

rows.source: instead of this weak little trainee gear.
They were worried that I might hurt myself or get my gear stolen. Yeah right!
rows.current: text: 他们怕我伤到自己，或被抢走装备。真会瞎操心！

rows.source: ...wait...
rows.current: text: ……等等……

rows.source: As if I haven't already spent years studying up on all the safety protocols
rows.current: text: 说得好像我没花好几年钻研那些安全规程似的，更别说安全研究各种生物的种种方法了。

rows.source: nevermind all the various ways to safely study all sorts of creatures.
But nope, even a prodigy like me has to start off with a weakened lighttazer.
rows.current: text: 可偏不行，连我这样的天才也得先用弱化版光电击枪。

rows.source: But with all this roughhousing out of the way, how about we call a truce?
rows.current: text: 不过既然已经打闹够了，不如我们休战吧？

rows.source: I'm down here to figure out what's keeping fellas like you from thriving
rows.current: text: 我来这下面，就是要查清是什么让你们这样的家伙无法兴旺生存，

rows.source: so I know we'll work it out!
rows.current: text: 所以我知道，我们一定能解决的！

rows.source: Yes, Cosmobreeders...
rows.current: text: 没错，宇宙育种者……

rows.source: Trained in intergalactic standards of fauna management...
rows.current: text: 受过星际动物管理标准的专业训练……

rows.source: With our skills, we can turn around any planet, even a wasteland...
rows.current: text: 凭我们的本事，任何星球，哪怕是荒原，都能重获生机……

rows.source: Once we let our presence be known, on any planet of the galaxy...
rows.current: text: 只要我们在银河中的任何星球亮明身份……

rows.source: ...creatures just open up their hearts and souls to us!
rows.current: text: ……生物们就会向我们敞开心扉、坦诚相待！

rows.source: And with the combined efforts of all of us together, this planet will-
rows.current: text: 而只要我们大家齐心协力，这颗星球就会——

rows.source: H-hey! Come on now!
rows.current: text: 喂、喂！别这样嘛！

rows.source: I told you! We were on a truce now!
rows.current: text: 我说过了！我们现在已经休战了！

rows.source: O-oh, your poor head... And that poor door...!
rows.current: text: 噢、噢，你可怜的脑袋……还有那扇可怜的门……！

rows.source: You know, I was hoping to leave back the way I came...
rows.current: text: 我本来还想从原路回去呢……

rows.source: But now I just gotta hope that the ceiling doesn't...
rows.current: text: 现在只能盼着天花板别……

rows.source: ...do that!
rows.current: text: ……真那么干了！

rows.source: First my gear stolen, and now a ceiling collapsing on top of me?
rows.current: text: 先是装备被偷，现在连天花板都塌下来砸我？

rows.source: Can't I get ANY lucky breaks down here???
rows.current: text: 在这鬼地方，我就不能走一回运吗？？？

rows.source: ...wait a sec, what's that falling from up there...?
rows.current: text: ……等下，上头掉下来的是什么……？

rows.source: No way... it can't be!
rows.current: text: 不会吧……不可能！

rows.source: Oh, awesome! Now THIS is a lucky break!
rows.current: text: 噢，太棒了！这下真走运了！

rows.source: It's not every day that a hyper bracer falls into your lap!
rows.current: text: 超能护腕可不是天天都能捡到的！

rows.source: With this I'll be able to hyper slide my way out of here in a jiffy!
rows.current: text: 有了它，我就能靠超能滑行一溜烟冲出去了！

rows.source: Let's do this!
rows.current: text: 来吧！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Heh! Heh! Heh!
rows.current: text: 嘿！嘿！嘿！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Some of you little folks have some proper fight in you... Heh!
rows.current: text: 你们这帮小个子里，还真有几个能打的……嘿！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: I'd almost thought that the lot of you were merely an annoyance
rows.current: text: 我还差点以为，你们这群家伙只会惹人烦，没想到还真有一个打中我了。呵！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: but here's one that actually manged to hit me. Heh!

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: What's next, one of you coming along and knocking me down to-
rows.current: text: 接下来呢，你们还想来一个把我也撞——

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Come on, I beat you fair and square! Stop trying to act cool.
rows.current: text: 得了，我可是堂堂正正打赢你的！别装酷了。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: You know I'm a better fighter, and I accept your defeat.
rows.current: text: 你知道我身手更强，我也接受你的认输。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: No more harm will come to you so long as you tell me whe-
rows.current: text: 不会再伤你，只要告诉我在—

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: W-what?? How did you get behind me so fast???
rows.current: text: 什、什么？？你怎么一下就到我背后了？？？

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Harm? My little yellow furred companion? You wish to tell me of harm?
rows.current: text: 伤害？黄毛小朋友，你要跟我谈伤害？

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Perhaps you'd like a lesson in just such a topic as "harm"
rows.current: text: 也许你想亲自上一堂关于“伤害”的课

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: and then you can recite it to me, no?
rows.current: text: 然后再背给我听，如何？

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.current: text: ……好痛……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Y-yeah... I can... I can tell you a lot about harm... now.... oow....
rows.current: text: 是、是啊……现在……伤害这事，我懂得可多了……嗷……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: ...j-just lemme get my breath back...
rows.current: text: ……就、就让我喘口气……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Here, spunky yellow boy. Take your leave of my domain.
rows.current: text: 好吧，有股冲劲的黄毛小子，离开我的领地吧。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: And while you're at it, take this garbage that a fellow small fighter left
rows.current: text: 顺便，把另一个小个子战士留下的垃圾带走。我当时给他的教训，可比给你的还要狠。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: after I had given him an even rougher lesson than yours.

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: With shoes in hand, Yiffai scrambles out as the Redbull drops deeper into the mines
rows.current: text: 伊吠拿着靴子爬出去，红牛则深入矿井，他泛着红光的鬃毛诡异地隐入黑暗……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: his glowing red mane fading eerily into the dark...

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Woah, you really took a beating, lady!
rows.current: text: 哇，你可真是挨了好一顿揍啊，女士！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: But you look just as fresh as you did when I first entered here...
rows.current: text: 可你看起来还是跟我刚进来时一样精神……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: You're really one of those immortal elves, ain't ya?
rows.current: text: 你真的是那些不朽精灵中的一员，对吧？

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Correct, my young sir. I am Enelye, the Immortal High Lady of the Tutone Elves.
rows.current: text: 没错，年轻的先生。我是恩莉耶，图托恩精灵的不朽至高女领主。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: I must commend your most respectable performance in the art of combat
rows.current: text: 你在战斗技艺上的表现令人肃然起敬，我必须予以赞扬。即便对我这样年长的人而言，观赏这场表演也十分愉快。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: it was a highly enjoyable act to watch, even for one as old as I.

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: It was so enjoyable, that I believe you are due for a reward.
rows.current: text: 实在是太令人愉快了，我想你理应得到一份奖励。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: So please, sit back and relax while I...
rows.current: text: 所以，请坐好，放松下来，让我……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: ...reward... you suitably...
rows.current: text: ……好好地……奖励你……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: H-hey! Come on lady! You gotta be making some mistake!
rows.current: text: 喂、喂！拜托，女士！你肯定是弄错什么了！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Aaaaa!
rows.current: text: 啊啊啊！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: ...w-wait! No! Don't do that!
rows.current: text: ……等、等等！不！别这样！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: ...n-no no no! I'm a boy! I don't wear these sorts of... dresses!
rows.current: text: ……不、不不不！我是男孩！我不穿这种……裙子！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: N-not that there's anything wrong with boys in dresses... but... b-but...!
rows.current: text: 倒、倒不是说男孩穿裙子有什么不对……可是……可、可是……！

rows.source: D-darn it! Come on Yiffany, don't you remember me?
rows.current: text: 可、可恶！拜托啊，伊吠妮，你不记得我了吗？

rows.source: It's me! Your little brother! Darn it!!!
rows.current: text: 是我啊！你的弟弟！可恶！！！

rows.source: Nnngh... d-don't worry, lil bro, I remember you...
rows.current: text: 唔……别、别担心，弟弟，我记得你……

rows.source: But give me another concussion and I can't say I'll keep on remembering you
rows.current: text: 不过你要是再把我打出一次脑震荡，我可不敢保证还能记得你，所以让我缓一会儿，行吗？

rows.source: so maybe give me a moment, eh?
Let me have at least... 5 seconds to clear my head before you swing...
rows.current: text: 你再动手之前，至少给我……5秒钟清醒一下脑子……

rows.source: and then I'll be able to throw you to the ground like old times, alright?
rows.current: text: 然后我就能像以前一样把你摔在地上了，好吧？

rows.source: You're back! Yiffany! Sister!
rows.current: text: 你回来了！伊吠妮！姐姐！

rows.source: All it took was 3 rounds of repeated blows to your head...
rows.current: text: 只不过是朝你脑袋反复打了3轮……

rows.source: ...but now you're back!
rows.current: text: ……不过现在你回来了！

rows.source: Help me up lil bro, it's not just my head that took the whacking all this time.
rows.current: text: 扶我起来，弟弟，这么一通打下来，挨揍的可不只是我的脑袋。

rows.source: I was under control of... a dark queen.
rows.current: text: 我之前被……一位黑暗女王控制着。

rows.source: I feel as if all my energy has been sapped out, now that I'm free from them.
rows.current: text: 如今摆脱了控制，我感觉全身的力气都像被抽干了。

rows.source: Don't think I'm fit for combat anymore, but here: take this.
rows.current: text: 我想我现在不适合再战斗了，不过，来，拿着这个。

rows.source: It's the whistle dad gave me when I first started to follow in his footsteps!
rows.current: text: 这是我刚开始追随爸爸的脚步时，他给我的哨子！

rows.source: Blow it practically anywhere and I'll be able to pick you up in your ship.
rows.current: text: 几乎不管在哪儿吹响它，我都能开着你的飞船来接你。

rows.source: If nothing else, I can be your pilot while you play at hero this time, okay?
rows.current: text: 别的不说，这次你逞英雄的时候，我至少还能当你的飞行员，好吗？

rows.source: Wham! Wa-chow! Ka-POW!!!
rows.current: text: 砰！嘿咻！看——招！！！

rows.source: How'd ya like THOSE moves, buddy? Can't just launch yourself at a Cosmobreeder
rows.current: text: 伙计，这几招滋味如何？可不能对宇宙育种者扑过来，

rows.source: and not end up on the receiving end of the PPP's renowned combat lessons!
rows.current: text: 却不领教一下PPP久负盛名的格斗课程！

rows.source: Good thing you stopped when you did. One more counter from me and yo-
rows.current: text: 幸好你及时停手了。我要再反击一次，你就——

rows.source: ["Counter", my friend? Surely you jest.]
rows.current: text: [“反击”，我的朋友？你一定是在说笑。]

rows.source: [As a father, I have much experience in play-fighting with pups such as yourself.]
rows.current: text: [身为父亲，我可没少陪你这样的小崽子打闹。]

rows.source: [My true powers are far beyond anything you can comprehend!]
rows.current: text: [我真正的力量，远远超出你的理解！]

rows.source: [...but for now, you may experience a mere taste of my PSY powers!!!]
rows.current: text: [……不过现在，你可以先尝尝我精神力量的一点皮毛！！！]
text: ……

rows.source: ...bark?
rows.current: text: ……汪？

rows.source: [Bark indeed, my little friend.]
rows.current: text: [没错，就是汪，我的小朋友。]

rows.source: [Now, perhaps in order to get you accustomed to this new PSY-forced form]
rows.current: text: [现在，为了让你适应这个被精神力强制变成的新形态，]

rows.source: [you can demonstrate some of these amazing "counters" that you believe you have?]
rows.current: text: [不如展示一下你自以为会的那些精彩“反击”？]
text: ……
text: ……好、好疼……

rows.source: G-good to be back to my old self now but...
rows.current: text: 变、变回原来的自己真好，不过……

rows.source: ...yeah, t-that old dog can really fight... ouch...
rows.current: text: ……是啊，那、那条老狗可真能打……疼……

rows.source: ...time to find me some Vitamins...
rows.current: text: ……该找点维生素了……

rows.source: ...or a place to fall asleep... ow...
rows.current: text: ……或者找个地方睡一觉……疼……
text: ……

rows.source: ...gee Dad, did you have to be so rough on that guy?
rows.current: text: ……哎，爸爸，你非得对那个家伙下这么重的手吗？

rows.source: I've never seen you fight with someone like that before!
rows.current: text: 我以前从没见过你那样跟谁打过！

rows.source: My son, that "guy" was able to accept and master our ESPer powers
rows.current: text: 儿子，那个“家伙”竟能接受并掌握我们超能力者的力量，

rows.source: in the span of a single battle.
rows.current: text: 只用了一场战斗的时间。

rows.source: He very well may be the one to save this world from the sorry state it's in.
rows.current: text: 他很可能就是能把这个世界从困境中拯救出来的人。

rows.source: Wow, Dad! I thought you didn't believe in the rumors of "Cosmobreeder" heroes!
rows.current: text: 哇，爸爸！我还以为你不相信“宇宙育种者”英雄的传闻呢！

rows.source: ...this one is different, son. They may indeed be a true hero...
rows.current: text: ……这一个不一样，儿子。这位或许真的是英雄……
